title: Ruleset hardening: promote three mechanical rules to Error
summary: Three AL linting rules (AL0606, AA0161, AA0448) are promoted from warnings to errors, requiring developers to fix deprecated `with` statements, narrow the scope of intentional `AssertError` uses in test infrastructure, and replace technical field/table names with localized captions in user-facing messages.
key_points: AL0606 rule promoted: refactor 17 diagnostic-derived suffix sites to remove deprecated `with` statements and qualify record members explicitly
AA0161 rule promoted: restrict intentional `AssertError` uses in test libraries to ID-qualified pragmas with documented acceptance rationale
AA0448 rule promoted: replace 50 flagged `FieldName`/`TableName` expressions with localized caption equivalents in user-displayed messages
Ruleset count reduced from 72 to 69 rules
Developer extensions must fix these violations at source; broad suppressions no longer permitted
